remarks:
Residential Lot Zoned R3 for Single Family Development. Lot size is 83.31 x 198.58 on .31 acres. Property
currently has water and sewer connections as well as electric and gas. The photos provided are all aerial
photos with the proper borders identifying the boundary lines. According to the Town of Amherst
Zoning Department there is no Wetland Jurisdiction Determination required so it is fully developable.
Additionally, the property does sit on a 500-year flood plain. For additional information please reference
the Town of Amherst Building Department and Zoning Department Website.
